history.headline: Grumpy Walrus sold 1M SNEK (~2,701 ADA) at 11:32 AM and bought ~2.07M MEPE (~1.5k ADA), ~2.5k NIGHT (~553 ADA) and ~2.42M CITY (~202 ADA). Bigger story since the last desk log (Nov 5 6:15 PM): a Nov 6 7:45 PM-12:33 AM sell-off of ~12k ASCEND (~13.0k ADA, bag ~308k), ~7M SNEK (after ~10.4M SNEK came in from outside), ~2M SOLADA (two 1M dumps), ~2.75M MEPE, plus SHARKY/FEED/GUINEA/BANK/CITY exits and two more likely COCK LP pulls, with ~38k ADA sent to outside wallets; net ADA since Nov 5 ~+247. ASCEND side ~1.151M (53.5% above line), COCK ~127.1k (15.3% under). TMZ and WAR new swarm Pass + SW-01 pending_gate; 21 older pending swarm launches failed the gate (no pool, or TCM pool ~5.5k). Nothing passes k/y; no SW-01 ticket.
